description: Day-1 RELEASE GATE. Implement money()/fmt() classification from decoded IEEE-754 bits (exact decimal expansion) with half-even at true ties, matching Python f"{x:,.2f}" byte-for-byte. Intl.NumberFormat halfEven and bare toFixed are BOTH empirically wrong (L-001). Verify with: targeted boundary corpora (values below/at/above decimal midpoints across exponents, signs, −0, large magnitudes, non-finite) PLUS differential fuzz ≥1e5 random doubles vs python3, byte-compared. Seed long-decimal sentinels into fixtures. Deliverable: proven algorithm ready to become src/format.ts + evidence file.
title: Rounding spike: exact IEEE-754 money formatter matching Python
